stage_2_story.text_en:
Last Friday, David and his wife Sarah decided to eat at a new Italian restaurant called La Bella. David had called the day before to make a reservation, so they had a nice table by the window.

When they arrived, the waiter greeted them warmly and handed them each a menu. The menu was long and had many choices. Sarah ordered tomato soup as an appetizer, while David chose a Caesar salad. Both dishes were fresh and delicious.

For the main course, Sarah's entrée was a creamy pasta with mushrooms. David ordered the grilled salmon, which came with rice and vegetables. The portions were generous, and they both felt full after finishing their meals.

The waiter asked if they wanted a dessert. They decided to share a slice of tiramisu, which was rich and sweet. To drink, they each ordered a beverage — Sarah had sparkling water and David had a glass of red wine.

At the end of the evening, the waiter brought the bill. The total was eighty dollars. David paid and also left a fifteen percent tip because the service had been excellent. They both agreed it was one of the best meals they had enjoyed in a long time.
